Subject: Re: Mid-cycle capacity increase and proration — OpenMart

Hi Marissa,

We need to add 10 more concurrent seats to our Dedicated pool effective 2026-03-15. Our billing cycle for this subscription runs 1st–31st of the month. Can you confirm how Redwood will proration the additional seats for the remainder of March and whether we'll get a single pro-rated charge or multiple line items? Also need to understand VAT handling — we're Dubai-registered and may require VAT on invoices.

If possible, please indicate the pro-rated amount so I can raise a PO.

Thanks,
Samir

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up.

Short version: Redwood issues a single pro-rated invoice for the remainder of the current billing period reflecting the incremental seats and any applicable taxes. The proration is pro-rata by day based on the effective date you specify (so adding seats on Mar 15 would bill for 17 days of service for the added seats for March).

I'll loop in Laura from finance to confirm the exact calculation and VAT handling. Can you confirm: 1) exact effective date (you mentioned 15th); 2) are the new seats using the same capacity tier as current (Standard Dedicated seats)? If you have a PO number ready, attach it and we'll include it on the invoice.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Hi Samir,

Thanks — I ran the numbers based on the Standard Dedicated seat price on your account (USD 1,200/mo per seat) and the 1st–31st billing period. Calculation below assumes an effective date of 2026-03-15 and 10 additional seats:

- Seat monthly rate: $1,200.00
- Daily rate (monthly rate / 31 days): $1,200 / 31 = $38.7097 per day (rounded to 4 decimals in calc).
- Days billed (Mar 15–31 inclusive): 17 days.
- Pro-rated charge for 10 seats: 10 * $38.7097 * 17 = $6,581.649
- Rounded invoice line: $6,581.65

We will issue a single pro-rated invoice (one line for "10 x Standard Dedicated seats — pro-rated Mar 15–31") plus any VAT. For VAT: please confirm the VAT registration number and whether OpenMart is exempt/zero-rated for this jurisdiction. If VAT applies, we'll add it as a separate line and display the VAT rate and amount on the invoice.

I've attached a draft pro-forma invoice and added the PO placeholder. Once you confirm the PO number and VAT details, we'll finalize and send the official invoice. The final payment terms on this invoice will follow your existing contract (Net 30 unless otherwise agreed).

Attachments: [Attachment: INV-PRO-RATE-OPENMART-20260304.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)]

Regards,
